items.headline: DeChambeau, Rahm's US Open Edge
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm are expected to be better prepared for the US Open than other LIV Golf players, addressing major concerns about LIV's preparation for majors.

items.headline: Thin PGA Schwab Field Boosts Leverage
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm gained leverage as the PGA Tour's Charles Schwab Challenge field at Colonial Country Club is weak, featuring only one top-10 OWGR player, J.J. Spaun.
